81:1: When the sun is folded up
81:3: And when the mountains are set in motion
81:4: And whenever pregnant camels are left untended
81:5: When the wild animals are gathered.
81:8: When the girl buried alive is asked.
81:9: For what sin was she killed?
81:10: And when the pages are spread out.
81:11: And when the sky is stripped off and removed
81:12: When the fire of Hell is stoked.
81:14: Every soul will know what it has prepared.
81:15: No, I swear by those that recede.
81:17: And by the night when it departs.
81:18: And by the morning when it breathes.
81:19: Indeed, it is the word of a noble messenger.
81:20: Possessing power, firm in the presence of the Owner of the Arsh
81:22: And your companion is not a madman.
81:23: And indeed, he saw him on the clear horizon.
81:24: And he is not stingy over the ghayb.
81:25: And it is not the word of an outcast devil.
81:27: It is only a reminder for the worlds.
81:28: For whoever among you wishes to go on the straight path.
81:29: And you cannot will unless Allah, the Rabb of the worlds, wills.
